description: Elevate your productivity with the Lenovo 110 USB-A Wired Keyboard (Part Number GY41U02460) — a reliable, no-nonsense input solution designed to seamlessly complement your Lenovo laptop or desktop setup. Built with precision and durability in mind, this wired keyboard connects easily through a USB-A interface, eliminating the need for batteries, Bluetooth pairing, or driver installations for a truly plug-and-play experience. The Lenovo 110 Wired Keyboard boasts a full-size layout with comfortably spaced keys and a standard key design that feels familiar from the first touch. Whether you’re drafting emails, working on spreadsheets, or typing up reports, its responsive keystrokes and quiet operation help minimize fatigue during extended typing sessions. The sturdy construction and reliable performance make it ideal for home offices, classrooms, and professional environments alike. With its compact profile and straightforward wired connectivity, this keyboard delivers consistent performance without latency or interference — perfect for users who prefer a simple, dependable accessory that works out of the box.
